subgroup_geo_interest_vs_civil_eo_placeb.note: Starlink/GPS placebos can hard-hit (station-keeping). Civil EO placebos are quieter controls for the GEO Luch/SY-12 narrative.

summary.interpretation: Past-only IF at each asof. Public t_peak marks evaluation windows for quant noise. Primary separation: GEO interest vs civil EO placebos (subgroup_geo_interest_vs_civil_eo_placebo). Metrics: hard hit, pre-peak mean, noise_ramp, first_fold_hit. Claims A+B use IF scores only.
